C1049.title: Why BYOD Fails at Enterprise Scale
keywords: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2025
C1049.summary: A Forbes article citing IBM's Cost of a Data Breach Report 2025 notes that phishing is the most common initial attack vector in confirmed data breaches, accounting for 16% of incidents. The analysis argues that BYOD fails at enterprise scale because personal devices increase the success rate of attacks like phishing, leading to data breaches.

references.title: Why BYOD Stops Working At Enterprise Scale - Forbes
